turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
red by
Cancel
Message from Alen Customer Experience Team: Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a normal return because damage during transit is not covered as a standard warranty issue. For purchases made through alen.com, order discrepancies must be reported within 60 days of receipt, and any return or exchange requires a Return Authorization on an Alen-provided FedEx return shipping label. If the item was purchased through a third-party reseller, that seller’s return policy applies.
